moves.reason: His team threw his way 15 times last game: more chances to earn points. We want to hire him because his coworkers keep giving him work. Need space on our team; another owner could get him first.

moves.reason: Our excellent pass-catcher returns from a scheduled week off. We plan to use him so his points count. Management has bravely discovered that employees on vacation do less work.

moves.reason: Minnesota's defense stops opponents; Reichard kicks the ball between the posts. Both could improve our points. He has made all 15 field-goal attempts. We favor a man who read the instructions on the goalposts.

notes: We won by just 1.84 points. Official coaching strategy: win by enough to count, but not enough to relax.
Only players in our scoring lineup earn us points. The bench is a very expensive waiting room.
